options: A third-party plugin unrelated to ServiceNow's own products
ServiceNow's own out-of-box workspace, built on UI Builder, for service desk and ITSM agents
A replacement for the entire Application Navigator on every instance
A mobile-only app with no desktop equivalent
questions.explain: Agent Workspace is ServiceNow's own out-of-box workspace built on UI Builder, aimed at agents handling assigned work.

questions.q: How does Agent Workspace lay out the assignment list and the open record?
options: Both are shown in one view, side by side, with no full page reload when switching records
The list and record can never both be visible at the same time
The record always opens in a separate browser window
There is no assignment list in Agent Workspace
questions.explain: Agent Workspace keeps the assignment list and the open record in adjacent panes on one screen.

questions.q: What is a contextual panel, as used in Agent Workspace?
options: A required field on every incident form
A collapsible side panel surfacing related information, like similar incidents or knowledge articles, without leaving the record
A setting only administrators can see
A popup that blocks the record until closed
questions.explain: Contextual panels surface related information — similar incidents, knowledge articles, related records — right beside the open record.

questions.q: Why does Agent Workspace save an agent time compared to working a queue in UI16?
options: It does not save any time over UI16
It automatically resolves incidents without agent input
Checking similar incidents or knowledge articles happens in a panel beside the record instead of a separate search-then-switch-tabs detour
It removes the need for an assignment list entirely
questions.explain: The time saved comes from not having to navigate away to look up related information, compounding across many records a day.

questions.q: Is Agent Workspace one fixed screen identical for every agent on every instance?
options: No — it's configured per role and per implementation, so which tables, panels, and actions appear can differ
Yes, every Agent Workspace looks and behaves identically everywhere
No — it only exists on instances with fewer than ten agents
Yes, because UI Builder cannot make per-role changes
questions.explain: Agent Workspace is configured per role using UI Builder, so a service desk agent's view can differ from a dispatcher's.
